title: ruehssia thomasii
intro: Ruehssia thomasii, commonly known as Himalayan Rue, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ruehssia thomasii include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help in wound healing and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Ruehssia thomasii include alkaloids, which have therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
